purpose: Non-destructive review packaging of the already completed Pymunk 2.26 contact/lifetime experiment. No result or measured source was changed to package this record.

lifetime.environment: 3 m x 3 m room with fixed walls and centered dock; zero interior obstacles

matched_d058_reference.comparison_limit: Reference ended at 30000; this is not an equal-horizon causal comparison or a trajectory-matched estimate.

lifetime.full_lifetime_byte_identical_regeneratio: not established; documented byte-identical fresh-process replay applies to the v3 contact acceptance only
lifetime.resource_estimate_discrepancy: Primary JSONL was estimated below 500 MB before execution; actual size is 3658110995 bytes. Run completed without disk failure; preserve and disclose this discrepancy.

executed_command.record: One foreground serial run, PID 33566; caffeinate -i and nice -n 10; command template and approved binding from VALIDATION-lifetime-v3.md, LIFETIME_STARTED and saved launch-preflight. The task record did not preserve a byte-for-byte shell transcript.

package_payload.note: Original run manifest copied verbatim; its primary-trace entry is intentionally absent from this GitHub package.

omitted_primary_raw.custody: Preserved untouched in the original local result branch/commit ad4514ee01021b06ef02b47a62939e63be15502c; deliberately excluded from this review branch and every pushed ref.

audit_limitations: Without the primary JSONL the package cannot independently inspect every one of the 100000 primary transition rows, including row-level observations, proposed/commanded wheel values, shaft state, energy/temperature values, charge phases, paired-contact/latch state, contacts and simultaneous contact identities, clearances, penetration/crossing checks, and termination fields. The summary JSON and its hashes remain available.
The replay uses 8338 recorded samples, not the complete stream; it is a visualization, not a replacement trace or new physics result.
The lifetime latch did not transition; charger cutoff behavior was not exercised.
The D-058 reference ended at 30000 transitions, so no equal-horizon or causal trajectory comparison is claimed.
No byte-identical full-lifetime rerun has been established.

checksum_policy.original_manifest: SHA256SUMS is preserved verbatim and retains the original checksum entry for the excluded primary raw trace; its complete original-run check is not claimed possible from this package alone.
checksum_policy.package_manifest: PACKAGE-SHA256SUMS is separate and verifies the delivered payload files, including DELIVERY-MANIFEST.json, without editing the original run manifest; it does not checksum itself.
checksum_policy.delivery_inventory: The private data/pymunk226-contact-prototype/delivery-inventory.md records the allowlist, preservation proof, retention recommendation, and validation/publishing state.

replay.limitations: No interpolation is represented as physics evidence; trail connects recorded samples. Browser provenance also records the file:// console message.

retention.current_decision: Preserve the original trace untouched; no deletion, backup, compression or cleanup is authorized or performed.
retention.future_condition: Only consider deletion after source/protocol/results and audit summaries are inspectable, software QA/exact-HEAD Sol review/current-HEAD CI gates pass, any chosen backup is checksum/restore verified, and Flo explicitly accepts the residual audit/reproduction trade-off and authorizes deletion.
